appearance_facts.fact: Chart title is 'United States vs Canada'.
Solid blue line represents United States data.
Dashed red line represents Canada data.
The 2013 data point for the United States is labeled '1257.35'.

printed_facts.fact: The 2013 application volume for the United States is 1257.35.
The 2013 application volume for Canada is 434.33.

public_definitions: Review the public infrastructure grant application dashboard, compare the 2013 application volume for United States and Canada, then open the country grant intake follow-up record for the country with the larger 2013 volume.
